title: You feel lost.
paragraphs:
You feel lost.
But God is guiding.
There are seasons when life feels like walking through fog.

You can’t see where the road leads.
You don’t know what comes next.
But God rarely reveals the entire journey.
He gives just enough light for the next step.
And sometimes the fog is where your faith grows the strongest.
📖 “Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.” — Psalm 119:105
If you’re in a confusing season right now, keep moving forward.
